subject: learning/ci-shared-execution-groups
statement: Hosted GitHub and Forgejo docs-gate now use the same cheap-then-expensive barrier as local code-gate run: a --cheap job covers every phase-1 check, then --group default --phase 2 and --group tests --phase 2 start only after it succeeds. ci-parity accepts --cheap and --group plus --phase, treats later-phase jobs that need the cheap worker as workers rather than aggregates, and refuses a later-phase job that has not already completed every earlier required check. The required check set is unchanged (DINV-1).
intent: Stop remote race from starting beside lint, matching the local phase barrier, without splitting the required check set.
rationale: quality and tests used to be independent --group jobs, so hosted race began at the same time as gofmt. Local run already waited for phase 1. The remote graph now waits too: cheap red skips coverage and race; the docs-gate aggregate still requires every worker including cheap.
fit_criterion: Hosted docs-gate.yml and the Forgejo source template run --cheap, then group-phase 2 jobs that need cheap. ci-parity rejects the old parallel --group layout once phase 2 exists, and accepts new phase-1 checks under --cheap without a workflow edit.

provenance.note: Hosted CI follows the local cheap-then-expensive phase order.
